bandit_captain.windup: the scimitar raised high over the right shoulder, coat swinging
bandit_captain.strike: the scimitar slashed down and across at the enemy at full arm's length, lunging, coat flaring

druid.look: a Barovian druid, a wild-haired human woman with leaves and twigs in her long dark hair, green face paint, a rough moss-green and brown hide robe with fur at the shoulders and a gnarled wooden staff
druid.windup: the free hand pulled back beside her shoulder with a small orange flame in the palm, the staff raised
druid.strike: the hand thrust straight out at the enemy with the flame leaving it, leaning forward, robe swinging

knight.look: a knight, a tall human warrior in full steel plate armour with a dark blue tabard bearing a silver dragon, an open-faced helm, a long cloak and a greatsword
knight.windup: the greatsword raised high over the head in both hands
knight.strike: the greatsword chopped down and forward at the enemy, leaning into the blow, front knee bent

mage.look: a mage, a gaunt middle-aged human spellcaster with a pointed grey beard, a deep purple robe with silver embroidery and a high collar, rings on the fingers and a spellbook on a chain at the belt
mage.windup: both hands pulled back beside the chest with a crackling violet light gathering between them
mage.strike: both hands thrust straight out at the enemy with a burst of violet light leaving them, robe swinging

priest.look: a priest of the Morninglord, a stern middle-aged human man in long white and gold vestments with a sunburst embroidered on the chest, a gold sunburst holy symbol on a chain and a flanged mace at the belt
priest.windup: the gold sunburst holy symbol lifted high above the head, the other hand on the chest
priest.strike: the holy symbol thrust straight out at the enemy with a burst of golden light, leaning forward

priest_acolyte.look: a young acolyte of the Morninglord, a human in a plain cream robe with a small orange sunburst embroidered on the chest, a wooden sunburst holy symbol on a cord and a small mace at the belt
priest_acolyte.windup: the wooden holy symbol lifted high above the head, eyes on the enemy
priest_acolyte.strike: the holy symbol thrust straight out at the enemy with a burst of golden light, leaning forward

scout.look: a scout, a lean weathered human ranger in a dark green hooded cloak, a brown leather jerkin, a quiver of arrows on the back, a longbow in hand and a shortsword at the hip
scout.windup: the shortsword drawn and pulled back low beside the hip, crouched, the bow slung
scout.strike: lunging forward with the shortsword thrust straight out at the enemy at full arm's length

tough.look: a tough, a broad brawny human thug with a shaved head, a broken nose and stubble, a studded leather vest over a stained shirt, rough trousers and boots, a heavy mace in hand
tough.windup: the mace raised high over the right shoulder, the left arm forward
tough.strike: the mace swung down and forward at the enemy at full arm's length, leaning into the blow

warrior_veteran.look: a veteran warrior, a grizzled human soldier with grey stubble and a scarred face, a dented steel breastplate over a padded dark red gambeson, an iron half-helm, a greatsword in hand
warrior_veteran.windup: the greatsword raised high over the head in both hands
warrior_veteran.strike: the greatsword chopped down and forward at the enemy, leaning into the blow, front knee bent

mimic.pose: Sitting on the ground like a closed chest
mimic.look: a mimic disguised as an old iron-bound wooden treasure chest, dark walnut planks with rusty iron bands and a lock, but with a row of jagged teeth along the lid's edge, a long wet purple tongue lolling out, two small yellow eyes on the lid and short sticky grey pseudopod legs underneath
mimic.who: a mimic, a treasure chest monster
mimic.windup: the chest lid gaping wide open into huge toothed jaws, tongue unfurling, the chest rearing back on its pseudopods
mimic.strike: the chest lunging forward with jaws snapping shut on the enemy, pseudopods lashing out
